capabilities.capabilities.smart_zone.generated_labels: Generated helper zone names are Smartzone-prefixed and survive native save/reload on a copied basecamp fixture

name: smart_zone.assignment_owned_basecamp_fixture_pty_generate_v4_20260924
description: Generate Smart Zone Manager helpers from a copied McWilliams basecamp fixture with native fast-scroll rectangle selection, then save and native exit.

steps.label: fresh_gameplay_before_zone_setup
steps.expected_visible_fact: the assignment-owned disposable world is active before input

steps.label: disable_safe_mode_before_zone_setup
steps.expected_visible_fact: safe mode is disabled

steps.label: open_zones_manager
steps.expected_visible_fact: Zone Manager is open

steps.label: add_basecamp_storage_zone
steps.expected_visible_fact: the zone type picker is open

steps.label: filter_zone_type_picker
steps.expected_visible_fact: the type picker filter is active

steps.label: filter_for_basecamp_storage
steps.expected_visible_fact: the picker is filtered to Basecamp: Storage

steps.label: select_basecamp_storage_type
steps.expected_visible_fact: Basecamp: Storage is selected

steps.label: accept_default_basecamp_storage_name
steps.expected_visible_fact: the default Basecamp: Storage name is accepted and first-corner selection opens

steps.label: enable_fast_scroll_for_first_corner
steps.expected_visible_fact: native look-cursor fast scroll is enabled

steps.label: move_first_corner_to_basecamp_footing
steps.expected_visible_fact: first point is moved approximately 50 tiles east and south toward the copied basecamp

steps.label: observe_first_corner_before_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: first-corner picker remains open at the copied basecamp footing

steps.label: confirm_first_basecamp_rectangle_corner
steps.expected_visible_fact: first corner is accepted and the second-point selector opens

steps.label: move_second_corner_across_basecamp
steps.expected_visible_fact: second corner encloses copied basecamp anchors and existing camp storage area

steps.label: observe_second_corner_before_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: second-corner picker is open before confirmation

steps.label: confirm_second_basecamp_rectangle_corner
steps.expected_visible_fact: the basecamp inventory zone is accepted and the Smart Zone Manager prompt opens

steps.label: accept_smart_zone_prompt
steps.expected_visible_fact: the Smart Zone Manager prompt is accepted and its result is shown

steps.label: observe_generated_zone_manager_result
steps.expected_visible_fact: the Smart Zone result and helper rows settle in the manager

steps.label: close_generated_zone_manager
steps.expected_visible_fact: the generated layout is closed and save confirmation is handled next

steps.label: confirm_zone_manager_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: zone manager changes are saved

steps.label: after_zone_manager_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: gameplay returns after zone manager save

steps.label: native_save_and_exit_after_generation
steps.objective: Use the current native save and quit owner, confirm the save, then use native main-menu quit and its confirmation.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the source-bound native process saved the generated layout and exited
